profile.headline: Software Engineer L6 at Frontdoor, Inc.
profile.summary: Software developer with full stack development experience in corporate environments.  Ability to quickly grasp problems, take initiative, and work to address them.  Very versatile in any team role necessary in order to meet goals.  Excel in creating modular code for maintainability and re-usability.  Background in Electrical Engineering.

positions.title: Software Engineer L6
positions.description:
* Architected and developed numerous Golang microservices
* Built React front end site
* Written unit tests, integration tests, and behavioral tests in Golang and React (using Jest) to make sure functionality remains the same as before and build confidence of the code
* Built Splunk dashboards to view logs in a visual way to help debug and get analytics
* Used Sentry.io and PagerDuty to proactively be notified, discover and squash bugs found in production
* Utilized Gitlab for continuous integration by building pipelines for each project
- more later -

React, Golang, Java, ATG, Mongo, SQL ... 
Gitlab, Docker, PagerDuty, Splunk

positions.title: Computer Programmer IV
positions.description:
* Contracted to USPS

* Worked in an agile environment to develop multiple internal-use applications built on Spring Boot and Angular
* Developed an application to view and analyze delivery data per ZIP Code and its projected growth in order to replace a pre-existing manual process to perform the calculation.  Application received high recognition by the Postal CIO and other clients for what it offers to the company
* Utilized graphing framework Google Charts
* Utilized geospatial mapping framework esri / ArcGIS
* Created database tables on Oracle with automated load jobs
* Wrote out API endpoints for application to access and modify data
* Heavily involved throughout deployment by writing out deployment scripts for architecture team
* Became the lead developer for Angular and worked towards a standard for additional teams to follow
* Responsible for participating in release process, vocalizing process to business during meetings, and worked with coworkers from other teams to meet goals.

Technologies:
* Java, Spring Boot, Angular 6, Google Charts, Esri, ArcGIS, SQL Developer, Bootstrap, Oracle, Maven, NPM, Node.js

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Contracted to Servicemaster

* Developed a web-based, enterprise-level e-commerce application for B2C and B2B using Oracle products (ATG, Endeca, BCC) and utilizing company-based web services and APIs
* Worked with a team in a SCRUM agile development framework with 2-week sprints
* Followed Continuous Integration to meet 2 week release cycles for every product
* Actively involved in meetings to gather business requirements and determining acceptance criteria and tasks
* Utilized JSP and Knockout JS for MVC and MVVM architecture (Java, JSP, DSP, ATG)
* Maintained a Content Management System (CMS) for business and architects to make or toggle changes and features when necessary (Oracle Endeca, Oracle BCC)
* Adjusted to team and project rotations to further knowledge and exposure within the company

Technologies:
* Java, JSP, Javascript, Bootstrap, Materialize, Knockout JS, DSP, Oracle ATG, Oracle Endeca, Oracle BCC, etc.
* Eclipse, SVN

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
* Contracted to FedEx Air Operations for 11 months (Jan '15 - Dec '15): 

* Developed in a team a Java GUI application built on Eclipse RCP used for planning and tracking of weight and balance distribution of cargo load onto a plane while meeting with FAA safety regulations
* Handled multiple concurrent users within the application by using JMS to actively update the user's view as new events come, allowing multiple agents working on the same flight
* Used MVC architecture, REST web services, and Hibernate to access SQL database holding flight data
* Utilized SWT Eclipse UI framework to create a multi-view application that will dynamically update its data
* Utilized JMS to actively send and receive update messages from multiple user interaction in the application

Technologies:
* Java, SWT, Eclipse MVC, Hibernate, JMS
* Eclipse, SQL Developer, Oracle Middleware

===

* Completed the Cook Systems International FastTrack'D Java Developer program, extensive 8 week program to learn java 5 days a week for 8 hours.

Technologies:
* Java, J2EE, Swing, Spring MVC/IOC, Hibernate, JSF, JSP, JMS, PrimeFaces, HTML, XML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, AOP, Swing, AJAX
* Eclipse, ANT, Maven, SVN, Wildcat, MySQL, ActiveMQ

projects.title: Active Flight Booking Web Service
projects.description:
•	Created a web service to handle flight services (i.e. searching, booking, canceling) for a user of the web service
•	Developed a front-end for the user web service and a back-end using "REST"-ful web service to provide the capability of creating further applications in the future
•	Prevented password leaks by hasing and adding salt to the raw password before sending it to the back-end for match testing.
•	Designed a login filter to prevent a user from viewing restricted pages before logging in
•	Designed a flight search algorithm to search for possible, valid flight routes between two locations from a randomly generated flight model.
•	Developed a JMS subscriber to receive messages and notify users of flight delays and arrivals upon logging in
•	Used JSP, Primefaces and CSS to improve user experience.

projects.title: File-Sharing Server GUI Application
projects.description:
•	Created an application to handle file transfers between a client and a remote IP server using Java networking sockets
•	Developed a server to utilize multiple threads in order to handle multiple clients requesting file transfers.
•	Designed and implemented the GUI using Swing API
•	Utilized JAXB framework to access XML configuration files for client and server apps.
